trials.claim: Plan 1 includes lifetime access to Labrika
trials.claimQuote:
### Plan 1: $68 (was $228)
- Lifetime access to Labrika
- You must redeem your code(s) within 60 days of purchase
- All future plan updates
- Stack up to 3 codes
- 500 keyword rankings per month
trials.reasoning: The binding terms describe access as a revocable limited license, and a lifetime buyer reports receiving no credits for several months, materially limiting the lifetime-access promise.

exhibits.quote: Labrika grants to you (and you agree to comply with) a non-sublicensable, non-transferable, non-exclusive, revocable, limited license to use:
exhibits.argument: Access is granted as a revocable limited license, not permanent lifetime ownership.

exhibits.quote: even if i bought a life time deal, i don't get any credits anymore since several month.
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports lifetime deal stopped providing credits for months.

trials.claim: Plan 2 includes lifetime access to Labrika
trials.claimQuote:
### Plan 2: $136 (was $456)
- Lifetime access to Labrika
- You must redeem your code(s) within 60 days of purchase
- All future plan updates
- Stack up to 3 codes
- 1,000 keyword rankings per month
trials.reasoning: The terms reserve the right to stop providing services at any time, and a lifetime buyer reports credits stopped for months, undermining lifetime access for Plan 2.

exhibits.quote: Labrika may also stop providing Services to you, or add or create new limits to our Services at any time.
exhibits.argument: Vendor reserves right to stop service or add limits anytime, undermining lifetime access.

exhibits.quote: even if i bought a life time deal, i don't get any credits anymore since several month.
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports lifetime deal stopped providing credits for months.

trials.claim: Plan 1 includes 500 keyword rankings per month
trials.claimQuote:
- Stack up to 3 codes
- 500 keyword rankings per month
- 10,000 page crawling credits per month
- Unlimited websites
- All Labrika features
trials.reasoning: Reviews show ranking checks are charged by depth, with 50 keywords checked to 100 results using all 500 credits, so the allowance is not 500 such keyword rankings.

exhibits.quote: Today i tried the app and added 2 keywords to check ranking till 100 results for a single location.
exhibits.argument: Shows ranking cost depends on depth of results checked, not one credit per keyword.

exhibits.quote: So if i track 50 keywords for single location but check ranking till 100 results then it used all 500 credit.
exhibits.argument: 50 keywords can exhaust the 500 monthly allowance, contradicting 500 keyword rankings claim.

trials.claim: Plan 1 includes 10,000 page crawling credits per month
trials.claimQuote:
- 500 keyword rankings per month
- 10,000 page crawling credits per month
- Unlimited websites
- All Labrika features
trials.reasoning: The scan complaint gives no website size to compare against 10,000 page credits, and the generic right to add limits does not show the stated monthly amount is not provided.

exhibits.quote: You can only fully scan your site once or twice a month if you buy one code.
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports one code allows only one or two full scans monthly despite 10,000 credits.

exhibits.quote: Labrika may also stop providing Services to you, or add or create new limits to our Services at any time.
exhibits.argument: Vendor can add new limits anytime, undermining guaranteed monthly crawling credits.

trials.claim: Plan 1 includes all future plan updates
trials.claimQuote:
- You must redeem your code(s) within 60 days of purchase
- All future plan updates
- Stack up to 3 codes
trials.reasoning: The binding terms say Labrika has no obligation to release upgrades and may discontinue or retire any feature at any time without notice, materially limiting the promise of all future plan updates.

exhibits.quote: From time to time, Labrika may, but is under no obligation to, release upgrades, fixes or new versions of the Service, although these upgrades may not be consistent across all platforms and devices.
exhibits.argument: Vendor states it has no obligation to release upgrades, contradicting all future updates promise.

exhibits.quote: You agree that Labrika has the right to change, modify, add to, discontinue or retire any aspect or feature of the Service at any time without any obligation to give you notice of any changes.
exhibits.argument: Vendor can discontinue or retire features anytime without notice, voiding future updates.
